title: What caused that outage
guide_zh: 作者解释 HN 约两小时的宕机，称服务器遇到内存容量限制。
author: pg
excerpt: HN was down today for around 2 hours. Sorry about that. The News server currently crashes a couple times a day when it runs out of memory. All the comments and stories no longer fit in the 2 GB we can get on a 32 bit machine. We'd been planning to upgrade to a new 64 bit server. In the meantime it was arguably a rather slow form of GC.
